scope: User persistence data privacy, data collection boundaries, and local containment

findings.pii_collected: NONE. No names, emails, phone numbers, traveler identities, or credentials stored.
findings.location_telemetry: NONE. No GPS logs, breadcrumbs, background coordinates, or telemetry stored.
findings.device_identifier_usage: NONE. UUIDs are used solely for local record PKs (tripId, stopId) and not linked to hardware IDs.
findings.cloud_leakage: ZERO. Database files are sandboxed to app-internal storage on Android and iOS.
findings.retention_policy: All data remains on-device until explicitly deleted by the user or when the app is uninstalled.

compliance.apple_privacy_manifest: COMPLIANT — Local database falls under app functionality without tracking
compliance.android_data_safety: COMPLIANT — Zero user data collected or shared
